# FORTUNA SIGNAL

> AI-assisted research publication. Plain-language token dossiers verified under FORA-01 (five questions, four verdicts). Free educational content — not investment advice.

## Start here
- [Methodology — FORA-01](https://ron-delhaye-studios.github.io/fortuna-signal-live/methodology/index.html): the five verification questions and verdict vocabulary.
- [Asset library](https://ron-delhaye-studios.github.io/fortuna-signal-live/tokens/index.html): every token, researched.

## Machine-readable dossier corpus

One Markdown summary per token: definition, what the holder owns, verification verdict, utility, key risks, primary source.

- [WTIC (WTIC)](https://ron-delhaye-studios.github.io/fortuna-signal-live/tokens/wtic.md): Class B — Redeemable claim on the underlying commodity, per the issuer's terms.
- [W150 (W150)](https://ron-delhaye-studios.github.io/fortuna-signal-live/tokens/w150.md): Class B — Voucher right — redeemable for access or product per the issuer's terms.
- [H2ON (H2ON)](https://ron-delhaye-studios.github.io/fortuna-signal-live/tokens/h2on.md): Class C — Utility token with documented uses; it makes no commodity backing claim.
- [PRELAUNCH (PRELAUNCH)](https://ron-delhaye-studios.github.io/fortuna-signal-live/tokens/prelaunch.md): Class C — Purpose unclear from available documentation.
- [MEMES (MEMES)](https://ron-delhaye-studios.github.io/fortuna-signal-live/tokens/memes.md): Class C — Thematic token — narrative exposure, with no documented utility.
- [Petro (PTR) (PTR)](https://ron-delhaye-studios.github.io/fortuna-signal-live/tokens/ptr.md): Class D — Tracks the commodity's price in cash — no physical delivery.
- [TeshuaCoin (TESHUA) (TESHUA)](https://ron-delhaye-studios.github.io/fortuna-signal-live/tokens/teshua.md): Class D — Claimed backing by water products — disputed by the SEC; see the dossier.
